recognize_zh: 普魯士藍鐵染色（核以紅色對比染色）下，許多紅血球系前驅細胞的核周圍排列著藍黑色鐵顆粒，部分呈半圈或環狀圍繞核，而非散在細胞質中；這就是環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts），是鐵粒母細胞性貧血的診斷依據。
features: Numerous erythroid precursors (small round red-counterstained nuclei) in the field
Blue-black siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear distribution, several encircling a third or more of the nuclear rim (ring sideroblasts)
Granules coarser and more numerous than in normal sideroblasts, which have 1-4 scattered fine granules
Additional precursors with fewer, non-ringed granules
Nuclear fast red counterstain; background red cells and scattered larger myeloid nuclei without iron
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue and nuclear fast red counterstain shows numerous erythroid precursors, many of which contain coarse blue-black iron granules arranged in a perinuclear distribution. Several precursors have five or more granules encircling at least one-third of the nuclear circumference, meeting the definition of ring sideroblasts, while others contain fewer scattered granules. Stromal iron in macrophages is not assessable in this field. Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts, supporting sideroblastic anemia in this clinical context (congenital forms such as ALAS2-related X-linked sideroblastic anemia).

ddx.dx: MDS with ring sideroblasts / SF3B1 mutation
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts look identical; distinguished by age, multilineage dysplasia, SF3B1 mutation, and absence of germline ALAS2/SLC25A38 variants.

ddx.dx: Acquired reversible sideroblastosis (alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc toxicity, isoniazid, lead)
ddx.vs: Identical ring sideroblasts; history, drug exposure, copper/zinc and lead levels identify the reversible cause.
Normal sideroblasts contain only a few fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than a perinuclear ring.
Macrophage iron is extracellular/stromal clumps in large cells, and siderocytes are anucleate red cells with granules, not nucleated erythroid precursors.
